parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale properly addresses both error targets. It removes the incorrect claim that locating the supply chain claim in the abstract/introduction makes the comment fully grounded, explaining instead that the missing-experiments issue has no pinpointable section. It also corrects the rubric misapplication by noting that the configuration described (specific issue, but authors cannot confidently identify the targeted part) corresponds to a mid-level grounding judgment, without stating a numeric score or gold label. The rationale preserves the correct observation that the comment clearly specifies what needs to be addressed (missing experiments on hard-constrained supply chain problems, showcasing applications beyond PDE learning). No evidence is invented, and the language is coherent and suitable for rescoring.
